episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her journey of closing over $140 million in real estate through YouTube without paid ads. She addresses common fears agents face when starting on YouTube and emphasizes the importance of authenticity. Sarah offers practical advice on using local knowledge for content creation and highlights the high ROI of YouTube for lead generation.
